_: Which root `check:*` gates need not appear as a CI step, and why. An entry is a DECISION with a reason, never a way to quiet a gate somebody has not got round to wiring up — if the reason is 'not yet', the remedy is the CI step, not a line here. See scripts/check-ci-roster.mjs. `ciOnly` is the converse (R9-R13, docs/TECH_DEBT.md #299): the `run:` commands CI executes that `pnpm prepush` does not, and the CI jobs prepush does not stand in for. Same rule: an entry is a decision with a reason, and a stale or contradicted entry fails.
__advisory: ADVISORY gates need NO entry here and must not have one. They are read out of `ADVISORY_GATES` in scripts/prepush.sh — the one place that declares them (ADR-0124 D4: advisory is a declaration, not a number any tool can reach) — and the gate asserts they run in no CI step (R3a) and carry no second reason here (R4a). This file held `check:reconcile-due` until 2026-09-11, with a comment claiming the derivation already existed; it did not, and three of the five M5 specialist reviews found the same back door independently: add the CI step AND delete the entry — the natural pair, since an entry saying 'need not run in CI' looks redundant once it does — and both gates reported OK while a product-owner decision became a blocking gate.

jobs.e2e-api: Needs a real PostgreSQL and a booted API; prepush excludes database work by design (scripts/prepush.sh header) and scripts/e2e-local.sh api is the local equivalent.
jobs.e2e-web: Needs a browser, the built web app and a database; prepush excludes it by design and scripts/e2e-local.sh web:<suite> is the local equivalent. check:e2e-roster rosters its suite steps.
jobs.image: Builds the Docker images and smoke-boots them (ADR-0020); a contributor's machine is not assumed to have Docker, and the job is the only place the image is built.

commands.pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: A contributor's working tree is already installed; CI starts from an empty checkout.
commands.pnpm --filter @repo/api prisma:generate: Generates the Prisma client a fresh CI checkout lacks; a local install already holds it.
commands.git fetch --no-tags origin +refs/heads/m: CI's checkout fetches only the ref under test; check:frontend-only and check:engine-parity need origin/main as a merge base, which a local clone already has.
commands.pnpm build: Builds every workspace, including apps/api (nest build) and apps/seed-cli, which prepush never builds: lint, typecheck, test and check:web-bundle build only the packages and the web app. Whether a build can fail where typecheck passes is unmeasured, so these two builds stay CI-first; adding a prepush stage is a separate, measured change (ADR-0142).
